units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然患病，却不忘记那个右近，召她到二条院，赐她一个房间，叫她在此服侍。

en.t: Although Prince Genji was ill, he did not forget Ukon; he summoned her to Nijo-in, gave her a room, and had her serve there.

units.source_text: 惟光为了公子的病，心绪不宁，但也强自镇定，用心照顾这个孤苦伶仃的右近，安排她的职务。

en.t: Koremitsu was anxious over the prince's illness, but he forced himself to remain calm, carefully looked after the lonely and helpless Ukon, and arranged her duties.

units.source_text: 源氏公子病况略有好转时，便召唤右近，命她服侍。

en.t: When Prince Genji's condition improved slightly, he summoned Ukon and ordered her to attend him.

units.source_text: 不久右近便参与朋辈之中，做了这二条院的人。

en.t: Before long, Ukon joined the company of her peers and became one of the people of Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 她身穿深黑色的丧服[\[32\]](#part1333.html#m32)，相貌虽不特别俊美，却也是个无瑕可指的青年女子。

en.t: She wore deep black mourning clothes[\[32\]](#part1333.html#m32); though her looks were not especially beautiful, she was still a young woman with no fault to criticize.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“我不幸而遭逢了这段异常短促的姻缘，深恐自身也不能长久活在世间。

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "Unhappily, I encountered this extraordinarily brief bond of love, and I deeply fear that I myself will not live long in this world.

units.source_text: 你失去了多年来相依为命的主人，自然也很伤心。

en.t: You have lost the mistress on whom you depended for so many years, so of course you must be deeply grieved.

units.source_text: 我很想慰藉你，如果我活在世上，你万事有我照顾。

en.t: I very much wish to comfort you; if I remain alive in this world, I will take care of everything for you.

units.source_text: 只怕不久我也会跟着她去，那真是遗憾无穷了。”

en.t: But I fear that before long I too may follow after her, and that would leave endless regret."

units.source_text: 他的声音异常细弱，说罢，气息奄奄地吞声饮泣。

en.t: His voice was extraordinarily faint and weak; when he finished speaking, he choked back his sobs, barely able to breathe.

units.source_text: 此时右近不得不把心中那种不可挽回的悲哀暂时丢开，一味担心公子的病况，不胜忧虑。

en.t: At this moment, Ukon had no choice but to set aside for a while the irreparable sorrow in her heart, and she worried only about the prince's illness, overwhelmed with anxiety.
